triage_candidates.statement: tc-A (re-raise of the implementer's tc-a, third data point): the four-copy rationale block has no repo-level guard. The same claim is hand-maintained in scripts/checklist_engine.py's header, tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py's docstring, docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md and tests/test_worktree_derivation.py's docstring. The only guard is check_three_copies.py, which lives under .agent-work/, covers three of the four, and is rewritten by each crew. It has caught real drift every time it was run, and drift has still shipped twice (rework 1's partial repair; this review's blocker). A repo-level test asserting the copies carry one claim would make the guard outlive the crew that wrote it. Not this gate's to build.

tc-B: scripts/spine_lifecycle.py's build_origin docstring carries the same two stale claims as the blocker, OUTSIDE this gate's allowed scope. It says the retired comparison is retired because 'a spine's worktree is derived from its path, and ownership is the lease' -- the first half now points at a rule the engine no longer implements, and the second is the unqualified pre-R1 ownership claim ADMIRAL_RULING-1 declared false as written. The passage landed at b8557ff4 and this commit could not have touched it without exceeding scope. This is the 'third such reference outside the two fenced files' the implementer handoff asked to be reported; the implementer's symbol-level grep could not see it because it never names the symbol. Route to g3 or to #610's wave.

tc-C: evidence scripts pinned to HEAD stop reproducing the moment the Commander commits. g2-implement-rework2/check_no_refusal_added.py diffs the WORKING TREE against HEAD, so once 84d949eb landed it exits 1 with 'the diff does not shrink scripts/' and 'removed set is []' -- vacuously, because working tree == HEAD. Its substantive claims still hold and I re-verified them against the correct base. Since this lane now commits as gates close (the #617 mitigation), every future evidence script should pin an explicit base commit rather than HEAD, or a reviewer will keep meeting red checks that mean nothing.
